content.text:
Anthropic IPO Didn’t Save the AI Trade
On Thursday, artificial-intelligence model maker Anthropic raised $117 billion in its blockbuster initial public offering and private placements, and now it is hoarding cash in anticipation of twin surges in both revenue and expenses. But hopes that the debut would be the catalyst to save the AI trade were dashed on Thursday and Friday, as exemplified by the iShares Semiconductor ETF, down 11% over the two days through midday Friday trading.
